Keysight Technologies (KEYS) posted Q2 2026 results, a demand signal for semiconductor test tied to AI chip scaling and 5G rollouts. HEALTHCARE & BIOTECH Hansa Biopharma (HNSA) struck a €115M licensing deal for IDEFIRIX in Europe and MENA, de‑risking regional commercial exposure and cash flow visibility. Valion Bio (VBIO) briefed senior Department of War and BARDA officials on entolimod for acute radiation syndrome in a joint engagement; involvement of BARDA/DoD can accelerate development and support funding pathways for biodefense candidates. Monopar (MNPR) announced publication of a Phase 2 study showing ALXN1840 significantly improves copper balance in Wilson disease—data that can affect regulatory and partnering prospects. GE Aerospace (GE) won a U.S. Air Force contract to advance the GE426 engine for an autonomous collaborative platform, supporting long‑cycle aerospace revenue visibility. ENERGY, CLEAN TECH & MATERIALS Anaergia (AMRC) secured a C$58M contract with Neogenyx Fuels to expand RNG deployment, strengthening backlog and multiyear revenue visibility in decarbonization infrastructure. Contract. Shoals Technologies Group (SHLS) opened a new Tennessee mega‑facility to support U.S. manufacturing of solar balance‑of‑system components, easing supply constraints for project developers. Celanese (CE) announced an engineered‑materials price increase, an input to margin modeling across downstream industrials and auto suppliers.
